method: Inspected 12 evenly spaced native frames in each of three fixed views, plus complete video metadata and trace/contact checks. Selected front view shows film transfer, rolling and released final plate.
observations: Loose film starts separate from plate.
Both arms place film; the robot then picks up and presses with the loose roller.
Final plate remains covered with well grid visible; roller is released.
No team identifiers or visible teleportation in inspected frames.
limitations: Wrist briefly occludes part of film during placement; this is an uncut fixed native view. Visual inspection is sampled, not a claim of watching every frame.
